subject: Hosted API commit uplift + tier reband — renewal coordination
messages:
From: Maria Chen <maria.chen@oliveretail.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com
Cc: procurement@oliveretail.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal questions — throughput uplift and SLAs

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the renewal reminder — we're excited to keep Redwood for hosted inference. Our usage has picked up faster than forecast and procurement asked me to surface two items before we sign the SOW: a) ability to bump our monthly committed tokens from 1,000,000 to 2,500,000 with a stepped discount schedule, and b) a hard/soft rate-limit policy for high-traffic days (we need clearer guardrails to avoid throttling spikes).

We also need to confirm whether a 99.95% latency SLA for 95th token-time is included if we move to the higher commit, and whether any additional on-call/phone SLA is available for this tier.

Can you share a short proposal we can route to procurement/legal? We aim to have terms signed by July 10.

Thanks,
Maria Chen
VP Product, Olive Retail

From: sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com
To: Maria Chen <maria.chen@oliveretail.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal questions — throughput uplift and SLAs

Hi Maria — great to hear usage is expanding. High level proposal below; attaching a redlined SOW for procurement.

Summary proposal:
- Monthly committed tokens: increase from 1,000,000 -> 2,500,000
- Effective discount: stepped rate (months 1–3 at 12% off list, months 4+ at 18% off list) if annual commitment signed
- Soft-rate limits: per-route soft ceilings with automatic burst pockets (20% monthly buffer) before graceful degradation to a compatible lower-cost model variant
- Hard-rate limits: configurable per-route enforced limits (we can set an admin threshold) — overages billed at negotiated OT rate
- SLA: 99.95% availability for inference endpoints (hosted API) at the 2.5M commit level; phone-based escalation add-on available for an additional fee

Next steps
1) I can share a redlined SOW and a short schedule showing monthly billing impact (attached).
2) If procurement okays economics, legal can sign SOW and I will route to finance for invoicing cadence.
3) Ops (cc Karthik) will set up canary rollout and per-route soft limits during onboarding.

Will loop in Hannah from renewal to fast-track approvals once you confirm economics.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Exec — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redlines_OliveRetail.docx

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Olive Retail — pricing sanity check + ops notes

Sergio — quick internal note before we finalize numbers for Maria.

Pricing check:
- Confirmed we can offer stepped discount (12% -> 18%) tied to annualized 2.5M commit. Finance OK with margins at those bands.
- Overage OT rate: $0.000065 per token (negotiable if they want a higher flat overage cap).

Ops onboarding notes (Karthik):
- We'll provision dedicated cache keys and enable prefix caching for Olive's top 3 routes to keep p95 token latency under 120ms in production.
- Canary plan: 2% traffic for first 24h, 10% next 48h, full cutover at 7 days if no regressions.
- Soft-limit behavior: return structured rate-limit header + 10s graceful fallthrough to lower-cost model. Ops will document runbook.

Hannah — want to own PO/invoice cadence confirmation and any promotional credit for early signature? Recommend $10k onboarding credit if signed by July 9.

Vanessa
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Maria Chen <maria.chen@oliveretail.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@oliveretail.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal questions — throughput uplift and SLAs

Thanks — this looks good. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 
- We prefer a single annual invoice (prepaid) to simplify internal budgeting. Can you provide an annualized quote with the stepped discount applied?
- For the SLA, can you add an SLA credit table to the SOW (we will request this from legal).
- On overages: can you cap overage exposure at 15% of committed tokens per month at the OT rate?

If you can get a final SOW with those three items (annual prepaid option, SLA credit table, 15% overage cap) we will route to finance and aim to sign by July 10.

Also, could you include the onboarding credit note? That helps speed approvals internally.

Best,
Maria

From: sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com
To: Maria Chen <maria.chen@oliveretail.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Final SOW and next steps — Olive Retail (DEAL-78421)

Maria — attaching final SOW (SOW_OliveRetail_v2.pdf) and the DocuSign envelope link. Summary of the agreed items: 
- Annual prepaid option included (1x invoice for 2.5M monthly equivalent at stepped discount: effective blended discount on annualized spend documented in SOW).
- SLA section now includes an SLA credit table (partial credits for <99.95% availability tiers).
- Overages capped at 15% of monthly committed tokens; any usage beyond cap requires pre-approval and moves to negotiated OT pricing.
- Onboarding credit: $10,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice if DocuSign completed by July 16.

Ops onboarding timeline and contacts are in the SOW appendix — Karthik will kick off the canary once the envelope completes.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/Olive-Retail-SOW-78421
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/78421

Please let us know if procurement needs any additional redlines; otherwise I will mark this as pending-signature and book the kickoff for 7/20.

Thanks again — excited to scale with you.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Exec — Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_OliveRetail_v2.pdf
